title: Step from a specified phase
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine on Boolean inputs, let $r$ be a natural number, and let $\mathrm{dec}:\mathbb{N}\to\{0,1\}$. If an amplified-machine configuration $C$ has phase $p$, then for either choice bit $b$, its next configuration is obtained by applying the amplified transition prescribed for phase $p$, the symbol under the input head, and the symbols under the work-tape heads.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine on Boolean inputs
$C$ is an amplified-machine configuration whose state is the phase $p$
